arguments.old_string:
``split_iter()`` yields lists of non-separator values. A separator will
    never appear in the output.
arguments.new_string:
``split_iter()`` yields lists of non-separator values. Once *maxsplit*
    splits have been made, remaining values are included without checking
    for separators. If *maxsplit* is zero, a single list containing all
    source values is yielded.
